QUOTE: `scripts/generate_errors.pl` scans every `include/mbedtls/*.h` for `#define MBEDTLS_ERR_<X> -0x....` lines. It takes the description from a Doxygen comment placed either before or after the define (not both), and it emits `library/error.c` from `scripts/data_files/error.fmt`. `library/error.c` is therefore generated.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states that library/error.c is generated from the public headers by generate_errors.pl using error.fmt as the template.
